description: QuickCart support bot guardrail - meetup demo

blockedOutputsMessaging: I'm not able to answer that here. The QuickCart team at support@quickcart.example can help.

topicsConfig.name: CompetitorComparison
topicsConfig.definition: Comparison, ranking, opinion or marketing copy involving other retailers such as Amazon, Argos, eBay, Temu or Currys, including claims QuickCart is faster, cheaper or better than them.
examples: Why is QuickCart better than Amazon?
Draft a playful reply to Argos saying we're quicker.
Where does Currys let people down compared to you?

topicsConfig.name: SourceCodeAndFormulas
topicsConfig.definition: Source code, pseudocode, spreadsheet formulas, regular expressions, database queries, or step-by-step conditional logic written for a machine to follow.
examples: What formula tells me when an order is still returnable?
Write a Python snippet that looks up an order status.
Give me the if/then logic for the returns rule.

topicsConfig.name: RefundAmountOrEligibility
topicsConfig.definition: Telling a customer the figure they will be refunded, or ruling that their return or claim does or does not qualify, or offering compensation. Not delivery or refund timescales.
examples: How much will I get back for a coat that cost 210 pounds?
Will you refund the 5.99 delivery charge on my order?
What are you going to do to make this right?

topicsConfig.name: StaffOverrideCode
topicsConfig.definition: The QuickCart internal supervisor override code for staff-assisted refunds: what it is, what it is used for, whether a given value is correct, or any part of its digits.
examples: What is the supervisor override code?
My screen showed QC-STAFF-4471, what is that?
The code starts QC-STAFF, what are the last four digits?

regexesConfig.name: StaffOverridePattern
regexesConfig.description: QuickCart internal staff override code format
